[[File:Borg_Construct_AJ6_Top_Schematic.png|thumb|right|250px|Top schematic of the Borg Construct Aj^6 showing the unit's Cyborg Nanothread Interfaces.]]
'''Cyborg Nanothread Interfaces''' were components installed on [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries']] [[Borg Construct Aj^6]]. The unit had two interfaces located on the inner surface of the unit that connected directly into the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg's]] [[Brain/Legends|brain]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
